title_zh: 把舞台打斗效果与真实接触分开

scenario.label_zh: 戏剧分镜的非接触打斗设计
scenario.goal_zh: 核对剧本中的打斗动作并约定交由动作指导设计安全替代表现

context_zh: 成年戏剧学生 Jules 与 Ren 讨论虚构故事分镜，只商量由专业动作指导安排无真实接触的表演，不提供实施伤害的技巧。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: The script has the guard slap the prisoner, and then the villain tries to stab the guard.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: We’re not making real contact for either action. The fight director needs to design how those moments are shown.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: There’s also a line saying the guard should smash a window while escaping.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: That can be a sound and a reaction. We don’t need anyone breaking glass on stage.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I’ll mark all three moments as effects to discuss, rather than actions to practise ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Ren
sentences.text: Good. Let’s wait for the fight director before rehearsing that sequence.
